name: AgentTalk
author: J.P. Ramackers
description: Talk to your opencode agents from a panel in the Omarchy bar: type a task or paste an error, pick the agent, and watch it work.

barWidget.description: A bar button that opens your agents: one conversation per agent, grouped by workspace on the left, the input on the right.

schema.label: Auto-approve tool permissions
schema.description: Lets an agent edit files and run commands without stopping for a question. With this off, a run halts at the first permission request until you answer it in a terminal.

schema.label: Default agent
schema.description: Agent selected when the panel opens. Empty picks build if opencode has one, otherwise the first agent.

schema.label: Working directory
schema.description: Where agents run. Empty means the directory of the window you are focused on, so a terminal in a project is the obvious answer.
